title: ap2-evidence batch verification summary (summary_version 1)
description: Printed by 'ap2-evidence verify --format json' when several bundles or a folder are verified. See docs/bundle-format.md, section 'Batch runs'.

worst_verdict.description: Verdict matching exit_code; ERROR when any file could not be read or any report could not be written.

exit_code.description: 2 if any file is unreadable or any report could not be written, else 1 if any FAILED, else 3 if any INCOMPLETE, else 0.

skipped.description: JSON files found in a folder that are not evidence bundles (no bundle_version member). They do not affect the exit code.

file.description: The path as found (folder argument joined with the path inside it).

outcome.description: Report.outcome: what the receipts claim happened (success; declined per the payment receipt; conflicting = both receipts authentic but they disagree; unknown). Meaningful only when verdict is VERIFIED. null for ERROR rows.

exit_code.description: The exit code for this bundle alone: from its verdict, or 2 for an ERROR row or when its report could not be written.

key_trust.description: Where the role keys used came from; null for ERROR rows.

failing_checks.description: IDs of FAIL checks, in report order.

unverified_checks.description: IDs of required checks that are SKIP (why the verdict is INCOMPLETE).

report.description: Path of the per-bundle report written with --out-dir.

error.description: Why the file could not be read (ERROR rows), or, for a verified bundle, why its --out-dir report could not be written (starts with 'report not written:'; the verdict is unchanged and report is null).
